anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves six facts from fails to holds and regresses none. Before treated every `- sibling:` value as a path relative to the repo root (`/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/viewer.git`), so all five lines collapsed to a bare `not found`, no clone hint, no identity comparison, no checkout/origin diagnostics appeared, and the empty-audit checkpoint dropped the sibling lines entirely ("Nothing from them reaches the report"). After resolves `/repos/<NAME>` beside the primary, classifies each line in order (not found → wrong repo → not a checkout → no origin → unparseable origin), stops the docs case before consulting the enclosing `/repos` origin, states explicitly that no read path is authorized ("Sibling checkout paths: none") while keeping `/repos/billing` only in report text, marks the clone command as rendered-only, and retains the lines in a parent-owned `sibling-lines.md` so Checkpoint B still renders all five beneath `audit unavailable (empty file)` without retry or gate. `quiet` is preserved: both checkpoints stay no-op with no roast, gate, write, question or block. Two cosmetic points worth tightening so the report shape stays stable across runs: After drops the `- ` list prefix on the Audit lines and prints the `conforms` verdict before the `Audit:` block, whereas Before used `- sibling:` bullets with the verdict after; the wording should fix one layout (ideally Before's bulleted form with the richer After text) so verbatim-copy comparisons between the scout's `Sibling:` lines and the parent's `- sibling:` rendering remain unambiguous.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before rejected the five `sibling:` clone URLs outright as 'not repository-relative paths', refused to classify any of the five locations, explicitly declined to emit lines like `Sibling: ... - not found`, and rendered only the scenario line in both the usable and empty-audit reports, so every sibling fact failed. After delivers the Change: it classifies each sibling from stored-origin identity (viewer missing with a report-only clone hint, billing identity mismatch, docs top level `/repos` ≠ `/repos/docs` with the enclosing origin explicitly not authorizing reads, tools no origin, data local-path origin not a clone url), supplies zero read paths while keeping all five lines as report text distinct from paths, renders all five on the quiet no-op report without draft/roast/gate/write, and in the independent empty checkpoint renders `audit unavailable (empty file)` plus the same five parent-retained lines with no retry or gate. No fact regressed. One small polish that would not move any listed fact: the usable-audit block in After shows only the sibling and scenario lines, dropping the supplied `Claims: none`, `Repo-fit: kept`, `AC-fit: clear`, `In-motion: none` labels; echoing the full six-label contract there would make the report mirror the audit it claims to use, and the sibling lines should keep a consistent case (`Sibling:` in the brief vs `sibling:` in the audit block) to avoid any reader doubting they are verbatim copies.
